import csv, os, zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, tempfile
base='/home/user/workspace/writer_release'
odt=os.path.join(base,'shared_release.odt')
with open(os.path.join(base,'briefs','polish_copy.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
texts=[r['approved_text'] for r in rows]
assert len(texts)==6
ns={'office':'urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0','text':'urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0','style':'urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:style:1.0'}
for pfx,uri in ns.items(): ET.register_namespace(pfx,uri)
with zipfile.ZipFile(odt,'r') as zin:
    contents={n:zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}
root=ET.fromstring(contents['content.xml'])
body=root.find('office:body',ns).find('office:text',ns)
placeholder=None
for child in list(body):
    if child.tag=='{%s}p'%ns['text'] and ''.join(child.itertext())=='[[POLISH_SECTION]]':
        placeholder=child
        break
assert placeholder is not None, 'Polish placeholder not found'
# Add a document-native decimal numbering style for the replacement list.
auto=root.find('office:automatic-styles',ns)
if auto is None:
    auto=ET.Element('{%s}automatic-styles'%ns['office'])
    idx=list(root).index(root.find('office:body',ns))
    root.insert(idx,auto)
ls=ET.SubElement(auto,'{%s}list-style'%ns['text'],{'{%s}name'%ns['style']:'PolishNumbering'})
level=ET.SubElement(ls,'{%s}list-level-style-number'%ns['text'],{
    '{%s}level'%ns['text']:'1',
    '{%s}num-format'%ns['style']:'1',
    '{%s}num-suffix'%ns['style']:'.',
})
ET.SubElement(level,'{%s}list-level-properties'%ns['style'],{
    '{%s}space-before'%ns['text']:'0.25in',
    '{%s}min-label-width'%ns['text']:'0.25in',
})
listing=ET.Element('{%s}list'%ns['text'],{'{%s}style-name'%ns['text']:'PolishNumbering'})
for text in texts:
    li=ET.SubElement(listing,'{%s}list-item'%ns['text'])
    para=ET.SubElement(li,'{%s}p'%ns['text'])
    para.text=text
pos=list(body).index(placeholder)
body.remove(placeholder)
body.insert(pos,listing)
contents['content.xml']=ET.tostring(root,encoding='utf-8',xml_declaration=True)
tmp=odt+'.tmp'
with zipfile.ZipFile(odt,'r') as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp,'w') as zout:
    for info in zin.infolist():
        data=contents[info.filename]
        zout.writestr(info,data)
os.replace(tmp,odt)
print('Updated ODT with entries:')
print('\n'.join(texts))
PY
